threads.body: [General] This version is explicitly required to stay synchronized with `conventions/src/main/kotlin/otel.spring-native-test-conventions.gradle.kts:12-13`, but that file still downloads `graalvm-reachability-metadata:1.1.9`; `conventions/build.gradle.kts:84` also still compiles the convention against `native-gradle-plugin:1.1.9`. Please update both coupled versions to 1.1.10 so native tests use matching metadata and plugin APIs.
